# Triangle Country Club

> A championship golf and country club in Triangle, Zimbabwe's south-eastern Lowveld. Established 1960. An 18-hole Par 72 course, 45 chalets, the Baobab Restaurant, and a base for Gonarezhou National Park — an affordable premium retreat within the Triangle Sugar Estate.

## Key facts
- Location: Ross Armstrong Way, Triangle, Masvingo Province, Zimbabwe (about 25 km from Chiredzi)
- Established: 1960
- Golf: 18-hole, Par 72 championship parkland course
- Other sports: cricket, tennis, squash, lawn bowls, swimming pool
- Stay & dine: 45 chalets, the Baobab Restaurant (known for Zimbabwean beef steaks), bars
- Also: cinema, conference and wedding/event facilities
- Positioning: the natural overnight base on the overland route to Gonarezhou National Park
